artefact: WS4 Test 6 — V1→V2 historical continuity, manual observation record
collection_method: HTTP GET via the session's web-fetch tool, unauthenticated, public endpoints only
provenance_warning: These observations were captured interactively, not by verify_apis.py. Record counts reported here are counts of objects visible in the returned array as summarised by the fetch tool and MAY be affected by response truncation. Timestamps, keys and empty/non-empty verdicts are reliable; exact counts at limit>100 are NOT. This file is a provisional evidence record. Supersede it by running verify_apis.py and committing feasibility_check_<date>.json.
headline_question: Does the Polymarket Data API return trade history predating the 28 Apr 2026 V1→V2 cutover?

test_6A_market_scoped_seed_markets.claim: 3/3 seed condition IDs returned trade records, all timestamped before the cutover.

observations.title_returned_by_api: Nicolás Maduro released from custody by January 31, 2026?
Will María Corina Machado win the Nobel Peace Prize in 2025?

depth_probe.note: Trades retrievable from ~6 weeks before the announcement, i.e. the full pre-announcement window this case study needs.

observations.title_returned_by_api: US x Iran ceasefire by April 7?

test_6A_market_scoped_seed_markets.schema_note: Identical field set on pre-migration and post-migration records. No V1/V2 schema divergence observed. transactionHash is present on pre-migration records, so on-chain cross-referencing of V1-era trades remains possible.

probe_market.title: Strait of Hormuz traffic returns to normal by May 15?
probe_market.why_chosen: Opened 6 days before the cutover and ran 17 days past it, so one conditionId spans both contract eras.

window_before_cutover.note: Dense trading right up to the final minutes before the 11:00 UTC cutover.

test_6B_boundary_continuity.conclusion: The same conditionId returns trades on both sides of the cutover. No discontinuity at the boundary.

test_6B2_wallet_identity_stability.closes_open_question: WS4 §6 open question 7 — are proxyWallet values stable across the V2 migration?
test_6B2_wallet_identity_stability.conclusion: The same proxyWallet address returns trades in both contract eras. Trader-level features can be computed across the boundary without an identity join.
test_6B2_wallet_identity_stability.caveat: Single wallet observed. verify_apis.py samples five; run it before treating this as general.

record.title: Will Donald Trump win the 2024 US Presidential Election?

closed_positions_deep_history.conclusion: Realised P&L is served for a position closed 18 months before the cutover. The profitability features in the brief are obtainable for pre-migration cases.

null_result_worth_recording.interpretation: Not evidence of missing history. This wallet's positions resolved worthless or were never closed as tracked. Do not treat an empty closed-positions array as an API limitation.

test_6D_scope_trap.claim: start/end appear to be IGNORED on an unscoped /trades call, but honoured when user= or market= is supplied.

unscoped_call_second_window.note: A second, different window returned the same current-day trades, so this is not a caching artefact.

test_6D_scope_trap.consequence: Any historical collector call MUST carry user= or market=. Walking the global feed by time window silently returns current data. Add this to the data dictionary and to code review.
test_6D_scope_trap.confidence: Two observations, one control. Re-test with verify_apis.py before writing it into the report.

unresolved.question: Is limit honoured above 100? Documentation states max 10000; every limit=500 request here surfaced exactly 100 objects.
unresolved.why_it_matters: Determines whether pagination is by offset, by time window, or both.
unresolved.how_to_settle: verify_apis.py test 7 — compare len(response) for limit=100 / 500 / 1000 on a high-volume market.

unresolved.question: takerOnly=true vs false record-count differential on pre-migration markets.
unresolved.why_it_matters: The default silently drops maker-side fills and biases position reconstruction (risk R4).

unresolved.question: Maximum retrievable depth. Confirmed back to 2024-10-28 via market scope; the documented ~3-year default floor was not probed to its limit.
